Step 02 · Dear love

Dear Krish,

Happy Boyfriend's Day to my favourite person. ❤️

I don't think I say it enough, but I'm genuinely so lucky to have you. You are my comfort person, my favourite notification, my biggest smile, and the person who can make an ordinary day feel special.

Thank you for all the tiny things — the laughs, the hugs, the random moments, the patience, and simply being there. I want a thousand more memories with you.

If I had to choose my favourite person again, I'd still choose you. Every time.

Love you endlessly,
❤️
